title: Clock time · countdown inline
description: Puts both readings on one line — "22:43 · 3 min" — with the clock time muted and the countdown inked, so the row stays a single baseline instead of two. Hours format renders as "23:44 · 1 h 4 min".

changes.intent: Prefix the countdown with the derived scheduled clock time and a separator, all inside the existing eta element so the row keeps a single grid cell and baseline.
changes.detail: Prepend a new .arrival-row__eta-scheduled span and a .arrival-row__eta-sep (' · ') span before the existing countdown number and .arrival-row__eta-unit inside .arrival-row__eta. scheduledTime is the same detail-only derived field as eta-clock-time.json. 'ahora'/'SALIENDO' rows are unchanged (no prefix).

changes.intent: Clock time reads as context, not the headline figure.
Visually separate the two readings without adding weight.
